'''''Alnus lusitanica''''', dubbed the '''Iberian alder''', is a species of flowering plant in the family [[Betulaceae]], native to Portugal and Spain.<ref name="POWO_77164770-1" >{{cite POWO |id=77164770-1 |title=''Alnus lusitanica'' Vít, Douda & Mandák |access-date=27 March 2023 }}</ref> 

A tree of [[riparian zone|riparian]] and other wet habitats, it is a [[tetraploid]] related to the diploid common alder (''[[Alnus glutinosa]]'').<ref>{{cite journal |title=Two new polyploid species closely related to ''Alnus glutinosa'' in Europe and North Africa – an analysis based on morphometry, karyology, flow cytometry and microsatellites |year=2017 |last1=Vít |first1=Petr |last2=Douda |first2=Jan |last3=Krak |first3=Karol |last4=Havrdová |first4=Alena |last5=Mandák |first5=Bohumil |journal=Taxon |volume=66 |issue=3 |pages=567–583 |doi=10.12705/663.4 }}</ref>
